newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slips slightly at yr-end.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slips slightly at yr-end.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was down 0.44 point or 0.06 percent after the 50-stock index on India's National Stock Exchange lost 14.15 percent or 1.58 percent to close at a provisional 897.55.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 20.27 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
